name: Olivia Huntley
description: Hospital coworker and genuine off-duty friend until the friendship fractured silently after a "big back" comment (BCT slang) that deeply offended her girlfriend. She never addressed it directly with JD. Filed the HR complaints that led to his termination. He was never told the original offense.
public_footprint:
From Potsdam, NY; SUNY Potsdam Class of 2025, Criminal Justice Studies, named to the President's List and Dean's List. Earlier a Potsdam High School track & field athlete (2019).
